#notes: Step row (blank sample). One job over the whole run. Blank cells are skipped, so --df_ref etc. are not passed here.
Moves each trimmed fastq into its own subfolder so the next step can be parallelized. depends_on=trim adds --dependency=afterok:<trim job id>.
scatter fans this step out into one script per sample; {sample} is substituted into every value. Use @samples.txt to read names from a file instead.
Override row (step AND sample filled). Replaces only these fields for SAMPLE_B1; everything else is inherited from the count step row.
A step whose name starts with '#' is skipped, so you can park a stage without deleting it. Columns starting with '#' (like this one) are notes and never become flags.
